notes.title: New defences, content & more 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have been working hard to include some of the things you want the most, and we are pleased to introduce some of new defences:

TESLA TOWER

This high powered tower can target multiple enemies and will release an electrical burst of energy, destroying anything in it's path. You may place up to 6 of these at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/59c0027ef2c1dbe90f159b93d0ea67bf04addd7a.png[/img]

WOODEN FORTIFICATIONS 

Two new wooden defences make their way into UZD today. They both deal damage to attacking enemies, and come in sizes 1x1 & 2x2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/b78f7a5ccb3c561f5568e5b2d49126d58f49cd68.png[/img]

TERMINATOR TOWER

Get ready to blow a hole in the infected. A super charged version of the TESLA TOWER is the TERMINATOR TOWER. Only 1 may be used at a time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/a529ce2d961999af496e7c7c68d1bc193594f0cd.png[/img]

IN OTHER NEWS

- We have adjusted the health and cost of other buildings to balance the wooden defences
- Limited the number of HESCO barriers that can be placed to 80
- Limited the number of electric grids/traps that can be placed to 50
- Updated Chinese translations (thanks to Minstuk)
- Updated Turkish translations (thanks to Mr.Ares)

COMING SOON

- Laser fences

Let us know in the comments what you think!
Thank you everyone

Terror Dog team

notes.title: Public Test beta & Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

From now on we will introduce new updates a little earlier on a beta branch. For those of you who wish to access the new content faster all you need to do is:

- Right click the game in your library and select properties
- Navigate to the beta tab
- Select the public-test branch 

This will set your game to the latest available version. To go back to the default simply opt out of all betas. Note that multiplayer only works for players on the same game version.

New changes available on public-test:

- Bug with turret reloading fixed
- Engineer drone turret lasers range reduced
- Large icon bug for players who join in progress fixed
- Witch enemy had a bug where the camera shake did not work, fixed
- Fixed a bug if the player died whilst on a gun turret they would re-spawn and not be able to move
- Fixed a bug where the engineer drone was not visible to everyone in some circumstances
- Performance increases on client side players

Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/629457fe1f2a3bc8ce40c1db0870516069857780.jpg[/img]

notes.title: QOL Fixes 1.01
notes.content:
Hi everyone, there were a few things we noticed not quite right with the 1.0 release and have addressed the following in this patch:

- Fixed a bug that stopped players who joined in progress getting their full skill tree bonuses
- When a player dies in multiplayer, you will now have a short delay before spectating others
- Medic invulnerability has been boosted to 3 seconds / 4 seconds / 5 seconds respectively
- 'Kill the boss' text will now disappear when the boss is defeated
- Updated game engine version to reduce likelihood of crashes
- Specialist starting sniper rifle can now be reloaded properly using the ammo crate
- Building icons will grey-scale correctly when they cannot be placed
- Fixed a bug where no map would be selected automatically when in high scores
- Specialist movement speed skill is now fixed and you will now move 10% faster
- Fixed a bug with faster reloading that meant reloads would take longer >.>
- Reduced amount of cash medic generates from other player's kills
- Fixed a bug with medic 'An apple a day' to correctly award 25hp each level
- The unlock all achievements achievement will now unlock instantly once criteria is met
- Fixed a bug with the UI that hid player getting hit texture animations (red around screen)
- Fixed a bug with the bridge map CCTV cameras
- Various other fixes

Keep slay'n!

notes.title: 1.0 Release
notes.content:
We are so happy to announce the release of 1.0 version of the game. There is a lot of updates which include:

- Skill tree & Level up system
- 4 new playable classes: Medic, Heavy, Specialist & Engineer
- Earn xp at the end of games to power up your characters
- Unlock powerful max abilities such as the gun drone (Engineer), Invulnerability (Medic), Berserk mode (Heavy) & Critical damage (Specialist)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/91d212b67b898ca8e5af478ced67705943a4ae11.png[/img]

ACHIEVEMENTS UNLOCKED
- 12 unlock-able achievements

HOST WITH PRIVATE, NAMED SERVERS
- Players hosting games can now name & set a password on them if preferred

- Disable slow-mo option has been implemented for solo players to toggle if they wish
- Sentries now target mini soupex & hell hounds more effectively

Thank you all once again for your support. Now go unlock some achievements! :)

notes.title: Game Rebalancing
notes.content:
We have made a bunch of rebalances to make the game, in general, a little easier to play:

- Normal infected deal 30% less damage to players and buildings
- Grabbing zombie deals no damage on grab
- Soupex boss has less health, and deals less damage in all forms
- Barkrex boss deals less damage to players and buildings
- Hell hounds do 50% less damage to players and buildings
- Cash modifier on easy has been increased from 1.25x to 1.5x
- Witch enemy has 10% decreased AOE damage
- Witch enemy deals 30% less damage to players

In other news we have revamped the upgraded weapon shaders, so they look a little bit better than before :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36343798/ea9e8efc332e6957f3538c3b8c14fd146e0100b2.png[/img]

notes.title: New Map: The Mall
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

At long last we have released the new mall map for you all to wreak carnage on!

This is an early access version of the map, as we intend to do a lot more including letting players access and watch short movie clips in the cinema.

- Roam and explore the new environment over two full floors
- Find a suitable place to build a base, pick a shop of your choice, a secluded part of the map or wherever the hell you want!

Today we bring you WEAPON UPGRADES!

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER beta
notes.content:
Multiplayer has arrived!

At long last you will be able to join other players in laying waste to the undead!

We have opened the host game & browse server options from the main menu. For the moment, joining a game currently in progress is disabled, so you'll have to be in the team from the starting lobby. We'll be working to enable that alongside fixing the remaining issues with multiplayer and continue to refine the experience.

So here we are:

- Multiplayer servers open (beta)
- Music library updated with 12 more awesome tracks
- Draw distance graphics setting is now available
- Fixed a shadows issue (illusion of floating characters)

We'll be pushing an update out in the next few days that will enable text chat in-game to help teams communicate better.

Look forward to playing with you all!
